name: James Birdsall
bio: a Representative from New York; born in New York, 1783; studied law; admitted to the bar in 1806 and was the first lawyer to settle in Norwich, Chenango County, N.Y.; surrogate of Chenango County, N.Y., in 1811; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Fourteenth Congress (March 4, 1815-March 3, 1817); member of the New York state assembly in 1827; one of the incorporators of the Bank of Chenango; moved to Fenton, Genesee County, Mich., in 1839 and later to Flint, Mich., where he died July 20, 1856; interment in Glenwood Cemetery.
